description: Reducto provides an API to parse documents into structured JSON for downstream LLM processing.

evidence.claim: Reducto offers a parse endpoint that returns structured JSON suitable for LLMs
evidence.notes: Example curl request to https://platform.reducto.ai/parse returning JSON chunks

evidence.claim: Authentication is performed via an API key passed as a Bearer token
evidence.notes: Instruction to set REDUCTO_API_KEY and use Authorization: Bearer $REDUCTO_API_KEY header

evidence.claim: API key can be obtained through a self‑serve login flow
evidence.notes: Commands 'reducto login' and 'reducto login' imply self‑service credential acquisition

evidence.claim: Reducto provides a command‑line interface (CLI) for parsing documents
evidence.notes: Commands 'pip install reducto-cli' and 'reducto parse' illustrate CLI usage

evidence.claim: Reducto supports a REST API for document parsing
evidence.notes: cURL example shows POST request to https://platform.reducto.ai/parse

evidence.claim: The API focus is limited to document parsing (narrow scope)
Reducto MCP server can be installed and used by agents
evidence.notes: Instruction to install with 'uvx mcp-server-reducto --login' indicates MCP availability

evidence.claim: Integration with Reducto is possible using provided code examples
evidence.notes: Python, Node.js, Go, and cURL examples show buildable integration
